_about: WCNETSWITCH class -- regression coverage for WC-NETSCOPE1/WC-ACCTFILTER1 (2026-07-17: board never scoped the WC connector to the game's network, so a reload came up mainnet on a testnet game; session restore was invisible to getAccounts()). Same shape as HBARXFER (qa/harness/hbarxfer-auto-spike.cjs) -- kflow-reported, testnet-only, on the retest grid.
title: WalletConnect network scoping survives a reload

hard_assertions: WCNETSWITCH-01: after a reload mid-signing, window.WC.getNetwork() reports the GAME's network, not the bundle's mainnet default
WCNETSWITCH-01: kdiag board:sign:saved fires (the Sign click actually completes) rather than board:sign:error
WCNETSWITCH-02: with NO user action after a reload, window.WC.getAccount()/getAccounts() surface the restored session on the game's network within ~15s (kwcEarlyScope)
oracle.benchmark: qa/harness/wc-netswitch-repro.cjs + wc-earlyscope-test.cjs (manual investigation harnesses, 2026-07-17) proved both failure modes live before the fix (64c41ba..3eb51a6); wc-netswitch-auto.cjs is the kflow-reporting automation of the same two scenarios.

network.note: mainnet excluded from the recurring cron on principle, same as HBARXFER -- see qa/harness/mainnet-smoke-auto.cjs for the separate, low-frequency mainnet check

pairwise_target: n/a -- both instances run every cycle, exhaustive

instances.benchmark: kflow run wcnetswitch-*, commit b957ddf, 2026-07-17 20:17-20:18 -- reload during the signing phase, network correctly reports testnet post-reload, Sign completes (board:sign:saved).
kflow run wcnetswitch-*, commit b957ddf, 2026-07-17 20:17 -- pair, reload, NO click: restored session visible (network+account+accounts all populated) within 2s.

fixtures.auto: qa/harness/wc-netswitch-auto.cjs -- testnet kWallet (:8790) paired sender + manual-entry recipient, two independently kflow-reported instances per run. Scheduled every 2 hours via qa/harness/wc-netswitch-cron.sh (crontab), staggered against hbarxfer-cron.sh so they don't contend for the shared testnet kWallet. Skips (no game created) if kWallet has pending items or a human is mid-approval, mode restored unconditionally after.
